# Browser dependencies

These pinned files are served locally; the site does not depend on a CDN or a build step.

- Marked 18.1.1: `lib/marked.umd.js` from the npm package `marked`. MIT license in `marked-LICENSE.txt`.
- DOMPurify 3.4.17: `dist/purify.min.js` from the npm package `dompurify`. License in `DOMPurify-LICENSE.txt`.

Marked parses GitHub-flavored Markdown. DOMPurify sanitizes generated HTML before insertion into the page.
